title: EXPLAIN ANALYZE Deep Dive
summary: Choose and verify explain analyze deep dive from workload evidence rather than index catalogs.
learning_objectives: Identify when explain analyze deep dive matches a concrete PostgreSQL query pattern.
Use EXPLAIN ANALYZE BUFFERS to compare estimates, actual rows, access paths, and buffer work.
Explain the read benefit, write cost, storage cost, and planner-statistics dependency of the design.
reflection_prompts: Which query predicate or operator made this index the right candidate?
What maintenance signal would make you drop or redesign it?
